data.title: Arab League Hosts 30th Symposium for Heads of Training Authorities in Arab Armed Forces
data.content:
Cairo, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The 30th Symposium for Heads of Training Authorities in Arab Armed Forces began today at the General Secretariat of the Arab League, with Algeria chairing the event and delegations from 16 countries participating.
    Over five days, the symposium will review a study titled "Education and Training Requirements for Multi-Domain Operations and Future Warfare." It follows preliminary discussions held last October by representatives of military training authorities and aims to produce a unified Arab study on the subject.
    In a statement, the Arab League General Secretariat said the symposium seeks to strengthen military cooperation and coordination in education and training, while enhancing the capabilities of personnel in Arab armed forces to meet the requirements of multi-domain operations and future warfare.
    
    -- SPA
